chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from 'Abdullah ibn Sinan said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) granted permission to the young women for going out during the two Eid festivals only to seek provision.

key_terms.اَلْعِيدَيْنِ: The two Eids (Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha)

ai.seo_question: What was the specific reason women were permitted to go out during Eid according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration to clarify the specific legal rationale behind the Prophet’s concession for women to attend Eid prayers. The hadith highlights that the permission was primarily granted for 'seeking livelihood' (al-ta'arrud li-l-rizq), suggesting that while general attendance is permitted, the underlying economic necessity was the key driver for this specific ruling in the early Islamic context.
